method: Three caption-blind observers (Claude) each saw only the image; a semantic adjudicator (Claude) saw only the contract and their observations, never the image. AI review is not clinical approval.
inspection: Rendered composite: slack gauze loop under the chin to a hand at lower right, with a motion arrow.

observers.label: Caption-blind observer 1 (Claude)
observers.observation:
Label: Caption-blind observer (Claude), not a clinician.

1. Head and neck from behind the right shoulder: back of head, right ear, cheek edge. Short brown hair, clipped sides.
2. Panel 1: white band around the head at forehead height, bow-tied at the back; a white rounded pad covers the right ear, drawn over the band. Panel 2: bow undone, pad gone, ear exposed; band still circles the head; its loose tail runs from the back, forward under the jaw, to a hand at lower right. Panel 3: bare head; a thin pale line runs just behind the ear, following its curve. No redness, swelling, stitches, blood.
3. No text. One teal curved arrow, panel 2: starts behind the head at band height, curves down and forward along the hanging tail, tip near the neck base. Suggests pulling or unwinding direction.
4. Cloth being pulled across the throat, since the tail passes under the chin.
5. Coming off: bow untied, band unwound by hand, then bare head. Pad removal not shown; whose hand unclear.

observers.label: Caption-blind observer 2 (Claude)

Label: Caption-blind observer (Claude), not a clinician.

adjudication.label: Semantic adjudicator (Claude)
recovered: a head dressing covering the ear in the first panel
a hand taking gauze away from the head in the middle panel
the bare head with the ear uncovered in the last panel
the dressing coming off across the panels rather than going on
forbidden_hits: the dressing being put on - Observer 2: 'Panel 2 could read as a strip being wrapped or tightened under the chin or neck'
the dressing being put on - Observer 3: 'Panel 2 could read as a strap going on, tied under the chin or around the throat'
adjudication.reason: All three observers recovered every required item and saw no text, but observers 2 and 3 each state that panel 2 could read as the strap being wrapped or going on under the chin, which is the forbidden 'dressing being put on' reading; observer 1's 'Cloth being pulled across the throat' traces to the same loose tail routed under the jaw.

outcome: failed: every required item recovered by all three, but all three read the under-chin gauze as cloth or a strap at the throat
notes: Strict rules. The throat reading is a drawing defect, not the reversibility of the action.
